Rosemary & Thyme

3 Series 22 Episodes Felicity Kendal & Pam Ferris Gardens of England & Europe Cozy Mystery

Felicity Kendal and Pam Ferris star as Rosemary Boxer and Laura Thyme, two gardeners whose work restoring beautiful gardens keeps leading them to murder. Created by Brian Eastman and Clive Exton, Rosemary & Thyme ran for three series and 22 episodes on ITV from 2003 to 2007, with later cases taking the pair to France, Italy, and Spain. It streams on BritBox in the US. See how the services compare in British TV Hub's guide to where to watch British TV in the US.

Main Characters and Cast

Lead

Felicity Kendal

Rosemary Boxer, a plant pathologist and former university lecturer in horticulture who starts over as a gardener after losing her academic post.

What Makes the Series Special

Friendship

Two Friends at the Heart of It

The warm, teasing friendship between Rosemary and Laura is the real draw, and Felicity Kendal and Pam Ferris make an easy, likeable double act.

At a Glance
PairingScientist and ex-police officer
A Gardener's Eye

Clues in the Flowerbeds

The pair's horticultural knowledge often provides the vital clue, giving the mysteries a gentle, distinctive angle that suits garden lovers.

At a Glance
ExpertiseHorticulture
Tone

Gentle, Traditional Mystery

Rosemary & Thyme is a traditional cozy whodunit, with beautiful settings and a light touch that makes it easy comfort viewing.

At a Glance
ToneGentle, good-humoured

Setting and Filming Locations

Setting & Filming

Gardens Across England and Europe

Each episode is set in a different garden, from English country estates, churchyards, and London parks to the French Riviera, the Ligurian coast of Italy, and southern Spain.
